message.text:
The `user` table maps to the `User` struct in `store/user.go`.

`attachment` maps to the `Attachment` struct in `store/attachment.go`.

`reaction` maps to the `Reaction` struct in `store/reaction.go`.

q15.

user: User — store/user.go  
attachment: Attachment — store/attachment.go  
reaction: Reaction — store/reaction.go

These are the store-layer models for the `user`, `attachment`, and `reaction` tables defined in `store/migration/sqlite/LATEST.sql`. The DB drivers (e.g. `store/db/sqlite/user.go`, `store/db/sqlite/attachment.go`, `store/db/sqlite/reaction.go`) read and write these structs against those tables.
